question:
A cube is made by folding the given sheet. In the cube so formed, which number will be on the face opposite to the face having the number '1'?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/79190e1eca473d87a46c89e799c6e3d6d81d1cb509333f6301e70643714be1e3.png]
solution: The logic followed here is: The opposite surface of the open dice can be found by the below method:- • Alternate surfaces are opposite to each other. • No two opposite surfaces are touched by side or by corners So, by using the above rule we can find the opposite surface of open dice.
